fullContent:
Chandrodaya Vati 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Chandrodaya Vati is an herbal medicine which aids in treating pterygium, abnormal growth over the eyes, cataract. This medication should be used under medical supervision. It helps in balancing Kapha and Vata. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Vacha (Acorus calamus) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) 
 Manashila (Realgar) 
 Shankhnabhi 
 Goat milk 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the ingredients and triturate with goat milk and form paste like consistency. 
 Dosage / Usage 
 This formulation can be applied as a paste on the inner side of the eye lids. It shouldn’t be used for more than 1 to 2 months. 
 Indications 
 
 Nyctalopia (Caused by deficiency of Vitamin A, it may not enable the person to see in dim light or at night) 
 Itching in the eyes 
 Pterygium 
 Abnormal growth over the eyes 
 Initial stage of cataract 
 Granular eyelid disorder 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage is discouraged. 
 It might cause irritation in the eyes if it is consumed without being prescribed by the doctor and in this case rinse your eyes with water thoroughly and consult your doctor. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
